lines.text: Nervous before a big moment? Don't tell yourself to calm down.
Say three words instead. I am excited.
Harvard researcher Alison Brooks had people say it out loud before singing karaoke or giving a speech.
They performed better than the people who tried to calm down.
Anxiety and excitement feel almost the same in your body. Racing heart, fast breathing.
So don't fight the feeling. Rename it.
Save this for your next interview. And follow, because tomorrow's trick works on other people.

post.title: Say These 3 Words Before Anything Scary #shorts
post.description: Brooks (2014): people who said "I am excited" before singing or public speaking performed better than those who tried to calm down. Reframe anxiety as excitement. #psychology #shorts #anxiety #confidence
